Our availability

Rental properties that become available are posted on this page on business days.

Please do not contact us if you don't see any residences available, as we will not be able to help you with that. Due to extremely high demand, it is possible that there are almost no residences available at any time.

We do not have a waiting list and cannot provide updates on availability, so please check our website regularly.

You have exclusive access to Novum residences!

Congratulations! You are among the first people who have access to booking residences for the first phase of Novum in Rijswijk.

Novum residences will be posted on this page every business day at 12:00 (afternoon) Dutch time. You are only allowed to book one residence, and only one person can book a specific residence. After booking, our rental department will take a look at your information and contact you as soon as possible.
